bits(value: int) -> string =>
    (0..32)
    |> map(position => "{(value >> (31 - position)) & 1}")
    |> join("")

two_s_complement(value: int) -> int => (value ^ -1) + 1

for value in [1, 42, 0, -1, 2147483647] do
